name: guided-code-review
description: Local Markdown walkthroughs with inline diffs and Git-staged review progress.

guidedCodeReview.syntaxHighlighting.description: Color inline diff source using installed TextMate grammars and the active theme. Unsupported or expensive files remain plain text.

languageModelTools.name: guidedCodeReview_captureReview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Capture the explicit Git repository/file scope in a saved Guided Code Review .review.md document. Writes or replaces its private .review.snapshot.json sidecar; never edits source, stages, commits, or approves. Returns immutable base SHAs, generated hunk IDs/positions, and validation issues without source contents. Use after authoring a review or changing its scoped code/configuration. Existing explicit hunk references may need repair using the returned IDs. Save review and source edits first; read the guided-review skill for the format and workflow.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Capture saved local changes into a private review snapshot.

documentPath.description: Absolute path to an existing, saved .review.md file inside the open workspace.

languageModelTools.name: guidedCodeReview_validateReview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read-only validation of a saved Guided Code Review document and frozen snapshot. Checks configuration, snapshot integrity, hunk references, coverage, and saved/unsaved source drift. Returns valid, issues, uncovered hunk IDs, empty blocks and counts. Does not capture, modify documents/source or change Git. Use after writing or clarifying a review, after capture and hunk-reference repair, and before presenting it. Tests and prose accuracy are not certified by this check.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Check review references, coverage and source freshness without changing files.

documentPath.description: Absolute path to an existing, saved .review.md file inside the open workspace.

languageModelTools.name: guidedCodeReview_openReview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Validate and open an existing, saved Guided Code Review document in its VS Code webview tab. Returns validation issues instead of opening if snapshot/references/coverage/source freshness are invalid. Never captures, rewrites the story or changes Git. Use when the user requests a review presentation and authoring/validation are complete.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open a validated local review presentation for reading and user approval.

documentPath.description: Absolute path to an existing, saved .review.md file inside the open workspace.
